how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DGFT Young Professional Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 16-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DGFT Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the DGFT Young Professional recruitment is 16 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Young Professional post by the Director General of Foreign Trade (DGFT).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's Degree in Economics, LLM/LLB with a PG Diploma, MBA, or a B.Tech/B.E./MCA/Masters in Data Science from a recognized institution. Specific details vary by specialization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Young Professional position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Young Professional post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Young Professional post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 56,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the DGFT Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the DGFT Young Professional recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Young Professional role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Young Professional post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Does DGFT offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify age relaxation details for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for this information.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Young Professional position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Young Professional position is on a contract basis.
